summary: Safe zone: a status widget under the compass (phase, countdown ticked by the kit, a bar drained by the client) and an alert when the zone moves. Per player.

panels.doc: The status widget. Author it `hidden`. `state-waiting|closing|final` is ZoneOptions.State, `outside` the player outside the safe zone. `at-*` (hud, top, band, bottom, tl, tr, bl, br, right) is ZoneOptions.Placement: a corner, or under the compass of the same placement. `icon-<name>` (ZoneOptions.Icon, ZoneIcons) overrides the state's icon; `icon-slot-N` is a picture another addon provides.
Label of the phase, `empty` when blank.
Label of the countdown, `empty` without one.
Label of the extra line, `empty` when blank.
Track of the phase bar, `hidden` without ZoneOptions.TotalSeconds.
The fill, drawn with `clip`. `step-N` (N of ZoneLayout.Steps) is the share of the phase left, with no transition; `dur-N` is the seconds left (ZoneLayout.Durations); `run` drains it to empty.
The alert. Author it `hidden`. `show` plays the entry, dropping it the exit. `icon-<name>` (ZoneAlertOptions.Icon, ZoneIcons) replaces the icon.
Label of the alert kicker, `empty` when blank.
Label of the alert description, `empty` when blank.

texts.doc: ZoneOptions.StateText, or the state's own text
